faq.q: Are French Bulldogs good with kids?
faq.a: Generally yes. The AKC says they are good around young children thanks to their size and lack of aggression, and the breed club adds that early socialization matters. As with any dog, young children should never be left alone with them.

faq.q: Are French Bulldogs good family dogs?
faq.a: They can be, for families who are home a good part of the day. Frenchies are affectionate and adaptable, but they need company, moderate exercise, a cool home and attention to their health.
Usually not. In a UK study of 2,781 French Bulldogs, the breed had lower odds of recorded aggression than other dogs. Some are possessive about food or toys, which can be managed with training.

faq.q: Are French Bulldogs good with cats?
faq.a: A well-socialized Frenchie usually gets along with cats, especially if they are introduced early. Go slowly with introductions and feed pets separately.

faq.q: Are French Bulldogs good guard dogs?
faq.a: Not really. The AKC says they are not a particularly vocal breed, and their small size and friendly nature make them companions rather than guard dogs.
